result.summary: Removes the `FillableSigningProvider` class from `src/script/signingprovider.{h,cpp}` and inlines its functionality directly into `LegacyDataSPKM` where legacy migration logic still requires it. Converts remaining call sites in `bitcoin-tx`, unit tests, fuzz tests, and benchmarks to use `FlatSigningProvider`. Also adds a guard in `src/script/sign.cpp` to prevent signing P2SH redeemScripts exceeding the 520-byte limit.
result.problem: Following the removal of the legacy wallet, `FillableSigningProvider` remained in the signing interface as an outdated abstraction primarily needed only for legacy wallet migration data. External call sites like `bitcoin-tx` and test suites still relied on it unnecessarily.

resolved_concerns: jeanpablojp identified that removing `FillableSigningProvider` allowed `bitcoin-tx` to sign invalid P2SH redeemScripts over 520 bytes; achow101 added a commit enforcing this limit in `SignStep`.
jeanpablojp noted missed pubkey and P2WPKH script insertions in fuzz targets, which achow101 fixed.

result.card: This PR removes the FillableSigningProvider class and inlines its remaining functionality into LegacyDataSPKM for legacy wallet migration, migrating bitcoin-tx and tests to FlatSigningProvider. It also prevents signing P2SH redeemScripts longer than the 520-byte MAX_SCRIPT_ELEMENT_SIZE limit. The change cleans up obsolete keystore architecture left behind after the legacy wallet removal. Reviewers have ACKed the approach and confirmed fixes for script size edge cases and fuzz test coverage. The PR is ready for review with no open dependencies.
